_comment: The tag identity post.ValidateContent applies (canonicalTag): whitespace runs collapsed, leading '#'s dropped, case kept.
Whitespace is Go's unicode.IsSpace set. Read by backend/internal/post/content_edit_test.go and by
frontend/src/entities/post/model/replacements.test.ts. "canonical": "" means the tag is refused as empty.

cases.name: collapses runs and drops the hash
keeps a hash after a space
a tab and a newline are spaces
a no-break space is a space
an ideographic space is a space
